title: China to host 200 training programs on digital economy and AI for Global South in next five years: Chinese Premier
authority_note: State-media report directly quoting the Premier's BRICS Summit announcement (originally Xinhua); defensible as a record of the official announcement, though Xinhua would be the primary source.
claims: China will launch the 'Digital South' initiative under the Global Development Initiative (GDI) framework
China will host 200 training programs on the digital economy and AI for Global South countries over the next five years
Announced by Premier Li Qiang at the 17th BRICS Summit, Rio de Janeiro (July 2025)
China welcomes all countries to attend the World Artificial Intelligence Conference to be held in China in July 2025
draft_usage: Cited for the 200 training programs / Digital South initiative claim under Social (Global South capacity building).
